closure.summary: Incident CASE-09 was caused by an RBAC permission deficit in namespace 'proofix-case-09'. The 'inventory-controller' workload executes 'InventoryServer.java' under ServiceAccount 'inventory-controller', which queries ConfigMap 'inventory-settings' via the Kubernetes API server using its mounted ServiceAccount token. However, the bound Role 'inventory-settings-reader' only granted 'get' permissions on 'pods' and omitted permissions for 'configmaps', causing API requests to be denied. Patching Role 'inventory-settings-reader' to grant the required ConfigMap permissions restored access and reconciliation, satisfying SLO requirements across consecutive evaluation windows.
